High triglycerides are a common metabolic concern that can affect heart health. Although triglycerides are a type of fat that the body needs for energy, elevated levels can increase cardiovascular risk. Very high levels, particularly 500 mg/dL or above, also raise the risk of pancreatitis.
In this video, Hansaji explains the common causes of high triglycerides and shares practical, natural ways to help manage them through diet, exercise and yoga.
You will learn how to:
1. Reduce added sugar, sweets, sugary drinks and refined carbohydrates without eliminating carbohydrates completely.
